rul.architecture: 9 feature input -> LSTM hidden 32 -> Linear 16 -> ReLU -> Linear 1 -> Sigmoid * 180
rul.normalization: Mean and standard deviation fitted on training units only
rul.selection: Minimum validation-unit MAE, epoch 49; checkpoint frozen before test evaluation
rul.runtime_time_policy: Causal interpolation of available chronological observations onto the trained one-second grid; reset after gaps over five seconds
rul.limitations: Virtual operating seconds for calibrated synthetic monotonic wear with level-9 functional failure; not real damaged-bearing lifespan. Stationary/recovering trends have no validated finite RUL.

psi.selection: Normal training windows only; no validation/test/live adaptation
psi.alarm: One MQTT warning on stable-to-drift transition; rearmed after stable recovery
psi.limitations: Distribution change can reflect wear, load, sensors or acquisition conditions; PSI is neither fault probability nor causal attribution
